# flutter_scale_kit

Pub: https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_scale_kit
Repo: https://github.com/fodilfliti/flutter_scale_kit

Responsive Flutter scaling (ScreenUtil alternative). Wrap the app with ScaleKitBuilder (designWidth/designHeight). Prefer SK* widgets (SKContainer, SKText) and SKit tokens (SKSize, ScaleKitDesignValues). Do not double-scale (no 120.w inside SKContainer).

## Agent skill (install in the consumer app)

npx skills add fodilfliti/flutter_scale_kit

Then: "Init Flutter Scale Kit with defaults."

If scale_kit.yaml is missing, the agent asks once for style (design_system recommended | drop_in | extensions | hybrid) and writes the file.

Skill files: skills/flutter-scale-kit/SKILL.md
User docs: README.md
Author/agent internals: spec/
